blockers.detail: LiveResearchGateService explicitly creates NOT_AUTHORIZED releases and exposes no command capable of authorizing one.
Research live-enabled is false, the worker egress policy is NOT_AUTHORIZED, and the controlled-egress allowed-host set is empty. Changing these values is an AWS task-definition/service mutation.
Exact-host URL, DNS, SSRF, redirect, timeout and byte controls exist, but the production crawl does not retrieve or evaluate robots policy before same-host page access.
The canonical deterministic M2-M5 worker exists in source, but Phase 1 Terraform defines only research-worker and controlled-egress ECS task/service resources.

minimum_successor_requirements: Add a fail-closed owner-approval applicator that creates separately represented REAL_PUBLIC_RESEARCH and RUN_PHASE_1_SLOT_1_ONLY records without changing the other six permissions.
Add deterministic robots retrieval/evaluation and provenance binding before any research page access.
Create a corrected immutable worker/runtime revision and exact-host controlled-egress revision for only 903hvac.com with browser and AI disabled.
Represent the deterministic M2-M5 worker in the Phase 1 runtime or provide an equally bounded deployed execution path with no delivery dependency.
Build, scan and bind immutable images, then generate an authenticated Terraform successor plan with zero unexpected replacements and zero unexpected destroys.
Keep ECS desired count zero and kill switch TRIPPED until a later exact Slot 01 run authorization is accepted.
reason_no_owner_statement: No hash-bound apply plan or immutable corrected runtime exists; emitting a live research approval would not bind an executable fail-closed path.
